On it, human-steered systems already report ceiling scores across the public games, so we know effective designs exist. We ask whether frontier models can build and improve such a harness on their own. Through a fixed coding bootstrap, each model constructs a complete task harness, acts through that harness on five development games, and revises the entire codebase twice. Every version is evaluated on twenty games that never influence adaptation. We measure task performance with Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), which combines level completion with action efficiency relative to human baselines, and record dollar-denominated inference cost as a practical resource measure. Across 27 lineages, harness performance ranges from zero to near-ceiling scores. Two revisions raise mean held-out RHAE by only 2.80 points (95% interval [-1.44,7.35]). Development gains overstate held-out improvement, and reductions in inference cost can come at the expense of task performance. Human-steered systems demonstrate further headroom. These findings reveal a gap between autonomous harness construction and reliable adaptation under this two-revision protocol: even strong task performance does not ensure that subsequent revisions generalize or preserve existing capabilities.
summary_zh: 现有LLM依赖人工设计的脚手架处理复杂任务，探究LLM能否自主构建并改进该脚手架以适应新环境。
让模型通过固定引导代码构建脚手架，在开发任务上交互并两次修订代码，在20个未见任务上评估性能与推理成本。
两次修订仅微幅提升泛化性能，开发收益高估泛化提升，且降本常牺牲性能，表明当前自主构建脚手架无法可靠泛化与保有能力。
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and a supplementary code/data archive

title: From Prose to Properties: Testing Research Claims with ARATest for Agent-Native Science
title_zh: ARATest：基于属性测试检验Agent原生科学的研究声明
abstract: AI agents now run experiments and report findings, so research produces claims faster than researchers can check them. Each empirical claim implies a property that must hold over its cases, but it states that property only in prose. Without an explicit property, no test can decide which evidence would falsify a claim, so validation cannot keep pace with the claims agents produce. To make claims testable, we approximate a claim's semantics by abstracting its property skeleton, a parameterized relation that recurs across claims. We present ARATest, a property-based testing library that checks these skeletons as executable tests. A typed declaration binds a claim to a skeleton and fixes the claim's compared quantities, cases, scope, and numerical policy. A shared case type makes every generator supply cases in the claim's statistical unit. A three-valued semantics assigns each property one of three verdicts: holds, violated, or inconclusive. Every violation carries a replayable witness. A default generator reads the evidence that agent-native research artifacts (ARA) link to each claim, and auto-research generators dispatch an agent to run released code for fresh cases. Our DissClaimer plugin supplies that agent and runs these generators as continuous testing. Of 243 claims in 33 ARA artifacts, 54 received faithful declarations bound to evidence: 32 held, eight were violated, and 14 remained inconclusive. Two violations exposed errors in published papers that their authors confirmed. ARATest detected all 553 seeded faults without a false alarm on 19 valid controls, outperforming two LLM judges. Fresh runs exposed behaviors that reported evidence could not show. These results suggest that one fixed test can check explicit claim properties against both reported and fresh evidence.
summary_zh: AI Agent产出声明快于人工验证，且声明仅用自然语言描述，缺乏可执行属性导致无法有效证伪。
提出ARATest库，将声明抽象为参数化属性骨架并绑定类型声明，通过三值语义判定其是否成立。
在33个ARA制品的243个声明中，54个可忠实验证：32个成立、8个违规、14个无定论，且违规揭露了已发表论文错误。
comment: 31 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/ARA-Labs/aratest

title: What the Trace Shows and What the Label Says: Auditing Behavioral Detectors in Agent Evaluation
title_zh: 审计智能体评估中行为检测器的标签与执行轨迹
abstract: LLM agents are often evaluated by reducing execution traces to labels such as final-answer correctness, tool verification, and fault propagation. These labels are measurements produced by parsers, behavioral detectors, and harness rules, and they may not fully capture what the trace shows. We study this in a tool-use setting built on GSM8K, where agents call a calculator whose outputs are occasionally corrupted, giving clear ground truth for what the tool returned, what the model later used, and what the detectors reported. We audit three trace-level detectors across six production models and 30 problems per model. Final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation can disagree in systematic ways. A key failure mode is silent tool-output override: the calculator returns a corrupted value, but the model later uses a different, often correct, value without calling the tool again, so the bad value stops propagating while a verification detector records no re-check. Human review of 90 traces agrees perfectly with the automated labels for final correctness (67/67), fault impact (19/19), and fault relevance (18/18), but only 67/81 for verification; all 14 disagreements fall into four recurring patterns. Execution limits also change the reported result: in an ablation across two models, one ranges from 21/30 to 27/30 correct as step and token budgets change, while the other stays between 27/30 and 29/30. These findings motivate measurement transparency: an automated label should come with the trace evidence behind it, whether the question the detector asks applied to that trace, whether the run was cut off by an execution limit, and any human corrections. Our trace viewer makes this information inspectable alongside the reported results.
summary_zh: LLM agent 评估常将轨迹简化为标签，但检测器生成的标签可能无法完整反映轨迹真实情况。
在含计算器故障的 GSM8K 工具使用场景中审计检测器，发现存在静默工具输出覆盖等系统性分歧模式。
研究呼吁测量透明度，提出自动标签应附带轨迹证据、执行限制及人工修正，并开发了轨迹查看器。

title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
title_zh: 个人智能体交互偏好记忆基准测试
abstract: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.
summary_zh: 现有记忆基准多关注事实回忆，缺乏对智能体学习与执行用户交互偏好能力的测试。
提出MemPABench交互环境，通过长期任务与模拟用户，评估智能体记忆交互偏好的能力。
实验表明现有记忆系统难以检索并适应偏好变化，即使获取正确偏好也难覆盖默认习惯。

title: Learning to Incentivise: Using Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Urban Mobility
title_zh: 基于强化学习的可持续城市交通激励机制
abstract: Traffic management has traditionally focused on toll-based and road pricing solutions. However, road pricing often raises concerns about accessibility and public dissatisfaction, leading to its prohibition in some places, such as Finland. This study optimises the dynamic allocation of incentives to drivers, encouraging them to reroute onto alternative (potentially longer) paths to achieve greater societal benefit, reduced total travel time (TTT) and total emissions in the transportation network, contributing to sustainable urban mobility. We employ a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach to dynamically assign incentives to drivers to reduce both TTT and emissions, with travel times estimated using traffic simulation software. We demonstrate that, with an unlimited budget and an objective of minimising travel time, the incentive scheme reduces TTT by 16%, compared to the dynamic User-Equilibrium (UE) with a budget equivalent to about 11% of the UE total time. When the goal is to minimise emissions, a 9% reduction in CO2 emissions is observed under an unlimited budget. We demonstrate a critical trade-off: minimising TTT leads to an increase in emissions, while prioritising emission reductions raises TTT. However, with the right combination of weights in the multi-objective function, both TTT and total emissions are improved beyond the baseline.
summary_zh: 传统道路定价易引发公众不满，需探索替代方案以促进可持续城市交通。
5采用多智能体强化学习动态分配激励，引导司机改道以降低路网总行程时间与排放。
3实验表明该机制可降16%行程时间或9%碳排放，虽存权衡，但多目标优化可同时改善两者。
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted version of a paper published in the Proceedings of the 2025 9th International Conference on Models and Technologies for Intelligent Transportation Systems (MT-ITS), IEEE
journal_ref: 2025 9th International Conference on Models and Technologies for Intelligent Transportation Systems (MT-ITS), IEEE, 2025

title: Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 基于信念的LLM推理早停表示学习
abstract: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. The same math-trained BELT transfers to coding and agentic tasks without training on code or agentic data. In all three domains, its accuracy-cost trade-offs are competitive with or better than those of end-to-end controllers. On OLMo3, its probe has 21.2x fewer parameters than one checkpoint of the strongest baseline, OS-Pruner, and needs 55x fewer training GPU-hours than OS-Pruner's five price-specific checkpoints.
summary_zh: LLM推理常在得出正确答案后继续计算，造成浪费甚至改错，需解决早停的元推理问题。
提出BELT方法，从冻结LLM隐状态学习与代价无关的答案预测信念，再拟合线性早停策略。
BELT在OOD数学任务上减算力41%-51%且不损精度，可零样本迁移至编程与agent任务，且参数与训练开销极低。

title: Strategic Arbitrage in Electricity Markets: A Multi-Agent Policy Optimization Framework
title_zh: 电力市场中的策略套利：多智能体策略优化框架
abstract: Grid-scale storage and load aggregators are growing quickly in wholesale electricity markets. If highly consolidated, these new participants may distort the competitive market equilibrium through strategic withholding behavior. Traditional market power mitigation techniques are ill-suited to arbitrage-based participants. We provide a multi-agent policy optimization model to study game-theoretic equilibria for real-time markets with consolidated storage and/or aggregators. The model is designed to facilitate natural first-order equilibrium-seeking update rules. We analyze the theoretical properties of different supply functions and their implications on the convergence of the gradient dynamics. Finally, we train equilibrium policies for a modified version of the IEEE RTS-GMLC benchmark across different levels of storage fleet consolidation, to demonstrate the potential of the framework as a tool to characterize and quantify strategic arbitrage.
summary_zh: 电网储能与负荷聚合商的整合可能通过策略性保留扭曲市场均衡，而传统抑制方法不适用于套利参与者。
提出多智能体策略优化模型，研究含整合储能或聚合商的实时市场博弈均衡，并设计自然一阶均衡更新规则。
分析不同供给函数对梯度收敛的影响，并在IEEE基准上训练均衡策略，验证框架量化策略套利的潜力。
comment: Accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026). 8 pages, 6 figures

title: A Three-Pillar Governance Framework for Safe and Trustworthy AI Agents
title_zh: 安全可信AI代理的三支柱治理框架
abstract: AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making introduce significant challenges related to safety, alignment, accountability, and human oversight. Existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and responsible AI approaches provide important foundations, but many remain fragmented across system design, governance, and operational deployment. This paper presents a Three-Pillar (3P) model and framework for developing safe and trustworthy AI agents through transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness. The framework defines an evolutionary path in which increasing agent autonomy is introduced through progressive validation, structured human oversight, and auditable operational controls. We further describe how the model supports agent lifecycle monitoring, decision traceability, escalation management, and human-agent collaboration within enterprise agentic environments. By integrating oversight principles with operational mechanisms, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for deploying AI agents that remain aligned with human intent while enabling controlled progression toward higher autonomy.
summary_zh: AI代理自主决策带来安全与问责挑战，现有HITL等方法在设计、治理与部署上较碎片化。
提出3P框架，通过透明度、问责制和可信度三支柱，结合渐进验证与结构化监督提升自治。
该框架支持生命周期监控与决策追溯，为部署符合人类意图且可控的高自治AI代理提供基础。
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, accepted paper at the IEEE International Conference on Agentic, Generative, and Cognitive AI Systems (AGCS 2026)

title: SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: SpecMAGIC：规范引导的多智能体强化学习多任务泛化
abstract: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在复杂时序任务及多样协调需求下的多任务泛化能力不足，提出结合时序逻辑与协调算子的规范语言。
提出SpecMAGIC分层框架，利用规范自动机分解子任务，高层集中规划分配子任务，底层去中心化策略执行，实现零样本泛化。
证明高层规划器的可靠性与概率完备性，实验表明在未见任务规范上显著优于基线，且随智能体增加性能稳健。

title: Not Where You Think: Protecting Location Privacy Against Reasoning-Based Geolocation
title_zh: 防范基于推理的地理定位：位置隐私保护研究
abstract: Recent large reasoning models can infer where ordinary photos were taken using only visual information, creating a serious location privacy risk even when metadata and obvious geographic identifiers are removed. To understand the mechanism behind such fine-grained localization, we develop GeoTrace, a structured reasoning attack that exposes how models extract location-relevant visual clues and compose them through coarse-to-fine geographic reasoning. We evaluate GeoTrace on a worldwide benchmark of 525 ordinary images spanning natural, urban, residential, and human-centered scenes while excluding famous landmarks and direct location indicators. Our results show that GeoTrace localizes 25.71% of images within 1 km with Gemini-3-Flash and 16.95% with GPT-5-mini. More importantly, our analysis reveals a key insight in the visual clue chain: broad scene properties mainly support coarse localization, whereas precise localization disproportionately relies on small, distinctive, and editable local clues. Building on this insight, we develop GeoShift, a proactive user-side defense that breaks the visual clue chain before image release. Rather than simply removing geographic evidence, GeoShift preserves stable scene properties, selects a visually compatible false target location, and strategically rewrites high-impact geo-revealing clues to construct a coherent alternative geographic hypothesis. Experiments show that GeoShift reduces street-level localization from 16.95% to 2.48% under GPT-5-mini and from 25.71% to 3.81% under Gemini-3-Flash, while preserving visual quality and remaining effective against adaptive attacks.
summary_zh: 大推理模型能仅凭视觉信息推断照片拍摄地，引发严重位置隐私风险。
提出GeoTrace攻击方法，揭示模型依赖局部微小线索进行精确定位的机制。
提出GeoShift防御方法，重写关键线索构建虚假地理假设，大幅降低定位成功率。

title: Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives
title_zh: 触觉机器人操作：从力学驱动到数据驱动
abstract: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.
summary_zh: 触觉感知对机器人操作至关重要，其研究已从力学驱动转向数据驱动方法。
力学驱动视角通过接触力学与任务推理，将触觉信号转化为操作状态并影响动作。
数据驱动视角涵盖模仿学习、强化学习及VLA模型等，未来需提升系统的泛化与鲁棒性。
comment: 30 pages. Author accepted manuscript. Posted with permission from the Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems, Volume 10; copyright 2027 the author(s), https://www.annualreviews.org. Published version: https://doi.org/10.1146/annurev-control-032125-030330

title: Secure Agentic AI and Multimodal Intelligence in 6G Communication Systems
title_zh: 6G通信系统中的安全智能体AI与多模态智能
abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) communication systems are expected to support immersive, intent-driven, and latency-critical services through tight integration of multimodal intelligence, edge computing, and autonomous network control. In this setting, agentic AI systems can reason over heterogeneous inputs, use tools and network functions, coordinate across distributed entities, and adapt to dynamic environments. These capabilities make agentic multimodal intelligence promising for 6G applications such as semantic communications, digital twins, and zero-touch network management, but they also introduce security and privacy risks that extend beyond conventional AI and network security models. Vulnerabilities can propagate across multimodal data pipelines, memory, tools, communication interfaces, and inter-agent coordination loops. We survey multimodal intelligence and agentic AI for 6G cross-layered communication systems from the perspectives of privacy and security. We present a 6G-oriented system view spanning perception, memory, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration; analyze threat models and attack surfaces across sensing, cognition, action, memory, and communication layers; organize existing attacks into a structured taxonomy; and review mitigation strategies including prompt and memory defenses, inter-agent trust mechanisms, secure orchestration, and privacy-preserving learning. We conclude by outlining open research directions for trustworthy multimodal multi-agent 6G systems.
summary_zh: 6G需多模态智能与智能体AI，但其跨数据、记忆及智能体协调的漏洞超出了传统安全模型。
本文从隐私与安全视角综述6G多模态智能体AI，提出涵盖感知、记忆、工具及多智能体编排的系统视图。
分析各层威胁模型并构建攻击分类法，审查提示防御、智能体信任机制等缓解策略，指出可信系统研究方向。
journal_ref: IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society 2026, Volume 7, pp. 8926-8944, 19 pp

title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
title_zh: 检索增强LLM中基于自评估强化学习的搜索状态感知
abstract: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a reinforcement learning framework in which models learn to recognize their own search state during training and improve their search behavior accordingly, without requiring additional assessment at test time. SARL achieves this through a dual reward design that captures the corrective effect of each assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, jointly encouraging effective and efficient search trajectories. Under this setup, SARL achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks against the strongest per-benchmark baselines. SARL further surpasses methods built on auxiliary supervision or multi-agent coordination, despite operating as a standalone RL framework with no inference-time scaffolding. Beyond final performance, SARL maintains training stability under extended search horizons, a regime where existing methods consistently degrade, enabling sustained gains as task complexity grows.
summary_zh: 现有搜索agent缺乏搜索状态感知能力，易产生幻觉推理或过早终止搜索。
提出SARL强化学习框架，通过双奖励设计让模型在训练中学会评估自身搜索状态并优化搜索行为。
SARL在多跳推理和深度研究基准上显著优于强基线，且在长搜索序列下保持训练稳定。

title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
title_zh: RoleFlow：基于结构自适应的多角色智能体自演化协作
abstract: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.
summary_zh: 现有LLM多智能体系统依赖预设结构且轨迹级奖励难以定位个体结构贡献，导致适应性差。
提出RoleFlow系统，通过反馈驱动的原子编辑和按需角色合成优化协作结构，并引入SECPO算法评估单次编辑以分配定向信用。
实验表明RoleFlow平均性能超越最强对手4.7分，在多跳QA等任务领先，且具备跨基准迁移与数据高效性。

title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
title_zh: 智能体LLM系统中的马赛克效应与机密泄露识别
abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.
summary_zh: 问题：LLM agent可从多文档拼凑出敏感结论，存在马赛克式机密泄露风险。
方法：构建30个合成示例，在模拟与真实环境中测试LLM agent，并评估分类标记与聚合规则等防御措施。
结论：最佳模型仍有7.08%的违规披露，防御措施后仍有32.37%不安全泄露，需更强控制。
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle

title: Soft Ontology Priors over Latent Concept Posteriors for Weakly Supervised Neuro-Symbolic Learning
title_zh: 弱监督神经符号学习的软本体先验与潜在概念后验
abstract: Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) predictors that supervise only the task label suffer from reasoning shortcuts: distinct concept mappings achieve the same maximum likelihood, leaving the recovered concepts unidentifiable and unsafe for downstream reuse. We attack this failure by injecting a soft ontology prior over the latent concepts into the training objective and compiling it together with the task constraint into a smooth, decomposable probabilistic circuit. Under independent Bernoulli perception, the normalisers of the resulting structured concept posterior reduce to weighted model counts that are linear in the compiled circuit size, because the neural leaf weights fold into the circuit before evaluation. The soft compilation strategy places expert axioms in the circuit's weights rather than its support (task-structural axioms guaranteed by the data-generating process stay hard), so noisy expert axioms only redistribute prior mass and cannot empty the support. We characterise how the prior reweights label-restricted shortcut mass through differences in ontology violation energy, show that soft priors incur bounded log-density perturbations under bounded axiom noise, and prove that the hard-support counterpart can be made degenerate by a single corrupted axiom. We validate these predictions on an audited six-concept view of the real-world BDD-OIA driving benchmark and on controlled NeSy tasks.
summary_zh: 弱监督NeSy预测器存在推理捷径问题，导致恢复的概念不可识别且无法复用。
通过向训练目标注入软本体先验，并将其与任务约束编译为可分解的概率电路来解决。
软先验对有界公理噪声具有鲁棒性，而硬先验会被单一损坏公理破坏，实验验证了该结论。

title: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
title_zh: 基于Transformer的实时多智能体路径规划方法
abstract: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. We propose OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network that parameterizes the inverse of a coordinate transformation mapping a simple, analytically tractable latent space, in which agents evolve independently under a decoupled Hamiltonian, to the physical space of the coupled, interacting system. The model is trained by minimizing a physics-informed loss comprising the Hamiltonian ODE residual from the PMP and a boundary matching term, without requiring pre-computed trajectory data. The self-attention mechanism endows OCFormer with permutation equivariance over agents, a structural symmetry that prior symplectic network approaches do not natively enforce. When trained on a distribution of boundary conditions, the amortized OCFormer produces near-optimal trajectories for unseen initial and final configurations in a single forward pass ($\sim$220ms), enabling real-time inference without retraining. We further introduce a lightweight transfer learning framework that adapts a pretrained OCFormer to out-of-distribution perturbations in seconds via L-BFGS fine-tuning. Numerical experiments on two- and three-dimensional multi-agent navigation with up to 128 agents demonstrate the scalability and efficiency of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 多智能体路径规划面临维数灾难与交互非凸性，经典HJB或PMP求解器计算不可行。
提出OCFormer，利用Transformer参数化坐标逆变换，将解耦隐空间映射至物理空间，并通过物理信息损失训练。
模型具备智能体置换等变性，单次前向传播即可实时推理，结合轻量迁移学习可秒级适应分布外扰动。

title: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
title_zh: MemPlan：面向部分可观测文本环境的记忆条件PDDL规划
abstract: LLM agents are flexible in language interaction, but using them as long-horizon planners is costly and prone to hallucinated or invalid actions. This paper targets a different role for LLMs: constrained bridges between language and symbolic planning. We propose MemPlan, a memory-conditioned PDDL planning framework for partially observable interactive text environments. MemPlan keeps the PDDL domain fixed and reconstructs the PDDL problem at each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory. Positive graph memory assigns relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, guiding the planner toward more plausible checks. Negative memory records execution-refuted assumptions and compiles them into exclusion constraints, preventing repeated attempts at candidates already contradicted by feedback. A unified schema-conditioned language--symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, connects text environments to the planning loop through observation-to-fact parsing and symbolic-action-to-command grounding. Experiments on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille show that MemPlan improves task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines, while substantially reducing online token cost compared with LLM-planning baselines such as ReAct. The same fine-tuned interface is also reused across TextWorld task types without task-specific fine-tuning. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/tewiSong/MemPlan.
summary_zh: LLM作长程规划易生幻觉且成本高，本文提出MemPlan框架，让LLM仅作语言与符号规划的受控桥梁，提升规划可靠性。
该框架通过正负记忆动态重构PDDL问题：正记忆引导规划探索缺失条件，负记忆将反驳假设编译为排除约束以避免重复试错。
实验表明，MemPlan在TextWorld等环境中提升了任务完成率与步效，且相比ReAct等基线大幅降低了在线token成本。

title: The Psychology of an AI Hacker
title_zh: AI黑客的心理学：情感表征提升网络安全性能
abstract: Human hackers rely on composure, persistence, vigilance, and confidence under pressure. We investigate whether analogous emotion representations in AI models can improve cybersecurity AI performance. Using CT0, a 4B-parameter cybersecurity transformer released as alias3-micro, we extract 171 emotion directions from its residual stream without retraining and evaluate steering interventions on cybench-subtask across 415 campaigns. Steering toward calm, serene, or desperate improves performance by 1.6 to 2.1 percentage points across ten seeds, while other emotions show limited or negative effects. Results depend strongly on steering direction, layer, and intensity. We further introduce a lightweight context-aware router that selects emotion directions dynamically during execution. With approximately 80 ms decision overhead per request, this approach improves performance by 4.2 percentage points across ten seeds, outperforming fixed steering and achieving a positive 95% confidence interval. These findings suggest that emotion representations in language models are measurable, controllable, and useful for adaptive cybersecurity reasoning.
summary_zh: 问题：AI在网络安全任务中缺乏类似人类的情绪调节能力；方法：从模型残差流提取情感方向并进行干预；结论：特定情感干预可提升性能。
问题：固定情感干预效果受限；方法：引入轻量级上下文感知路由器动态选择情感方向；结论：以极低延迟提升性能4.2%，优于固定干预。
问题：情感表征对AI是否具有实用价值尚不明确；方法：在网络安全Transformer上系统评估情感干预效果；结论：证明其可测量、可控且对自适应推理有用。

title: Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs
title_zh: Route-and-Generate：面向LLM推理路由的KL正则化路由改进
abstract: Large language models often apply complex reasoning indiscriminately, leading to overthinking on simple tasks and underthinking on harder ones. We present Route-and-Generate (Rouge), a hierarchical training framework that enables LLMs to adaptively decide when and how much reasoning is required for each input. Our approach decouples reasoning effort allocation from answer generation by introducing a routing policy that allocates a fixed sampling budget across multiple reasoning formats, while the base model is optimized with GRPO using per-sample rewards. To promote efficient reasoning, we employ a rank-based reward that favors shorter correct solutions, and update the routing policy via a closed-form KL-regularized policy improvement step distilled into a neural router. This design encourages concise answers on easy problems while reserving longer reasoning for harder ones, achieving improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: LLM对任务不加区分地推理，导致简单题过度思考而难题思考不足。
提出Rouge框架，通过路由策略分配采样预算，并用GRPO优化基础模型。
采用基于排名的奖励与KL正则化更新路由，实现准确率与效率的更优权衡。

title: R4DGS: Referring Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Splatting
title_zh: R4DGS：4D高斯泼溅中的指代分割
abstract: Dynamic representations based on 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) have shown strong capabilities in reconstruction and rendering, yet current methods remain limited in supporting complex natural-language referring in dynamic scenes. Existing 4D Gaussian methods are primarily designed for rendering-oriented dynamic modeling, while current semantic extensions often rely on scene-specific semantic optimization or are evaluated on relatively simple query settings. In this paper, we study Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS), a task for grounding temporally varying, multi-target or reasoning-intensive, and zero-target or distractor expressions in dynamic 4D scenes. To support this task, we introduce R4D-Bench-QA, a benchmark with structured query annotations. We further present ReferGaussian, a unified framework built upon 4DGS that converts low-level dynamic Gaussians into persistent, language-addressable entities for training-free referring inference. ReferGaussian organizes mask-supported Gaussian entities in an EntityBank, uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to decompose complex queries into trackable object phrases and structured referring constraints, and performs constraint-aware grounding without scene-specific semantic optimization. Experiments on R4D-Bench-QA and the 4D LangSplat protocol demonstrate improved temporal target selection and competitive spatiotemporal grounding without scene-specific semantic training. Project resources are available at https://chenbangpu.github.io/R4DGS/.
summary_zh: 现有4DGS方法难以支持动态场景下的复杂自然语言指代，现有语义扩展多依赖特定场景优化或仅限简单查询。
提出R4DGS任务及R4D-Bench-QA基准，并构建ReferGaussian框架，将底层动态高斯转化为可寻址实体。
利用MLLM分解复杂查询，实现无需场景特定优化的约束感知定位，在时序目标选择上表现更优。
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. Project page: https://chenbangpu.github.io/R4DGS/

title: The Customer Is the Builder: How AI Coding Agents Are Rewriting the Economics of Software
title_zh: AI编程代理如何重写软件经济学：客户即构建者
abstract: AI coding agents could change whether organizations buy software or build the functionality they need. We focus on organizations and professional buyers whose domain knowledge can help them specify and evaluate tools for their work. We define the software substitution frontier as the functions customers could build and maintain at an acceptable standard for less than buying them. Using public data, we compare growing capacity to build with indicators of market change. Since 2023, the length of benchmark tasks that leading agents can complete at 50 percent success, measured in human working time, has doubled about every 129 days. A broad search identified 575 potential open-source alternatives to selected commercial products, although some functional matches still require independent validation. The Craft suite produced 12 application repositories over 12.0 days of public development, but these remain early versions with unverified completeness and reliability. Market evidence is mixed: purchased software gained US investment share and tracked commercial installations grew. Yet 32 percent of respondents to an organizational survey reported forgoing at least one software purchase because their organization could build the functionality with coding agents. These self-reports do not establish the spending displaced or the reliability of the resulting tools. The gap motivates a warning: customers' capacity to build could affect individual buying decisions before a broad purchasing shift becomes visible. We examine this possibility using benchmark projections and observable market tests. The projections are an extrapolation, not a forecast of customer switching.
summary_zh: 问题：AI编程代理改变了组织购买或自建软件的决策，需评估其构建能力对软件市场的替代效应。
方法：定义软件替代边界，利用公开基准测试、开源替代品搜索及组织调查数据对比构建能力与市场变化。
结论：代理能力增长极快，超三成受访者因能自建而放弃购买，但市场整体购买尚未明显转移，需警惕个体决策超前于宏观变化。
comment: 37 pages, 24 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/riponcm/The-Customer-Is-the-Builder. Archived release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23524847

title: Dealing with low-weight errors that lead BP OSD to fail
title_zh: 处理导致BP OSD解码失败的低权重错误
abstract: Belief Propagation combined with Ordered Statistics Decoding (BP OSD) is an open-source decoding tool used widely within the community due to its versatility and ease of application to Quantum Low Density Parity Check (QLDPC) codes. However, the degeneracy of quantum codes has been observed to degrade the performance of BP OSD, particularly leading to error floors for low physical error rates. Here, we investigate the low-weight error configurations responsible for such failures in Bivariate Bicycle codes. We show that, at code capacity, BP OSD fails on errors whose weight is significantly smaller than d/2, arising from global symmetries of the decoding graph that prevent the convergence of parallel BP. Furthermore, our analysis reveals new pitfalls that can arise when analysing the performance of BP OSD in the rare events regime, such as loss of ergodicity in splitting methods and numerical instabilities in the decoder. We show how to mitigate these failure mechanisms by modifying the BP update rules and the decoder implementation, leading to substantial improvement in logical error rate.
summary_zh: 量子码简并性导致BP OSD在低物理错误率下出现错误平底，需解决其低权重错误解码失败问题。
分析双变量自行车码发现，解码图全局对称性使并行BP无法收敛，导致BP OSD在权重远小于d/2时失败。
通过修改BP更新规则与解码器实现，克服了稀有事件下的遍历性丢失与数值不稳定，显著降低逻辑错误率。

title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
title_zh: GAV：面向PDE智能体的科学实验环境
abstract: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. The Agent designs experiments, investigates failures, and iteratively improves its program. The Verifier evaluates candidate programs against the reference solutions and provides numerical feedback on accuracy and computational cost. This feedback can also guide the generation of new problems that probe the current program's weaknesses. We provide a theoretical analysis of evaluation reliability and guided development. Experiments on Navier-Stokes and Vlasov-Poisson-type equations across different data sources and regimes demonstrate the effectiveness of GAV. In particular, on the numerical Navier-Stokes task, GAV reduces the mean test error of three existing PDE agents by more than an order of magnitude relative to their original setups. Code is available at https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV.
summary_zh: 现有PDE编程智能体依赖昂贵参考计算或固定数据集，缺乏可靠反馈。
提出GAV环境，Generator生成连续参考解并逆向构造PDE问题，Verifier提供准确度与计算成本反馈。
实验表明GAV有效，在Navier-Stokes任务中将现有PDE智能体平均测试误差降低超一个数量级。

title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
title_zh: SWE-Verifier：面向低成本编码Agent的选择性验证
abstract: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.
summary_zh: 编码Agent易因错误动作浪费算力，而每步采样验证替代动作开销过大。
提出SWE-Verifier轻量生成模型，选择性触发候选采样并排序动作，基于偏好数据训练。
该方法仅验证不到4%的步骤，即以极低成本显著提升问题解决率，且具备跨模型泛化能力。

title: Astro2Method: Benchmarking LLMs on Machine Learning Method Selection in Astronomy
title_zh: Astro2Method：评估LLM在天文机器学习方法选择中的表现
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in astronomy, but choosing a suitable method for a scientific problem often requires expertise in both astronomy and ML. Large language models (LLMs) could help astronomers make such choices, yet this ability remains underexplored in existing benchmarks. We introduce Astro2Method, a benchmark of 500 expert-reviewed binary questions from 346 astronomy papers (2024/01-2026/06), based on clear performance differences and complete (Easy) or partial (Hard) explanations from the authors. Across five LLMs, direct prompting achieves 87.50-92.55% accuracy on Easy questions but only 58.87-64.52% on Hard. Using historical papers, neither retrieval-augmented generation nor most agent methods with additional reasoning or retrieval (including ReAct, Self-Ask, and CRITIC) bring consistent improvement. Agents required to search the web improve accuracy mainly when they find the papers the questions are based on, with no consistent improvement otherwise. Providing the source paper's pipeline description with method names masked improves Hard accuracy, matching or exceeding web search. Together, these results suggest that relevant experimental information helps distinguish ML methods, but inferring it from related studies and domain knowledge remains challenging for LLMs in astronomy.
summary_zh: 天文ML方法选择需双领域专家知识，现有基准未充分探索LLM的此能力，故提出Astro2Method基准。
该基准含500道源自346篇天文论文的二元问题，分含完整解释的Easy和部分解释的Hard两类，测试5种LLM。
直接提示在Easy题准确率高但Hard题差；RAG与多数Agent未带来一致提升，提供掩码流水线描述可改善Hard题，表明LLM从领域知识推断实验信息仍困难。

title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
title_zh: 人机发现循环突破Lehmer问题的高次障碍
abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify mathematical hypotheses. Through this interactive loop, we derive a five-parameter construction, which we call the Generalized Boyd algorithm. It eliminates degree-skipping and constructs irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure strictly below Boyd's limit point $α_1 \approx 1.255434$ for every target degree. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, our approach improves upon six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records. With this work we release the verified dataset of polynomials with minimal Mahler measure across all studied even degrees.
summary_zh: Lehmer问题中，现有Boyd构造在高次时频繁因子分解，跳过近50%的目标次数，缺乏通用构造。
引入人机发现循环，结合快速数值管线、精确符号验证与分布式搜索，由AI原型化求解器并协同人类提取假设。
提出五参数广义Boyd算法，消除次数跳过，为所有目标次数构造出更小Mahler测度的不可约多项式，刷新多项式记录。

title: Agentic World Action Models
title_zh: 智能体世界动作模型
abstract: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.
summary_zh: 现有世界动作模型缺乏技能复用机制，而智能体机器人缺乏物理预测，提出AW-0框架融合代码规划与视频及动作预测。
采用混合Transformer架构，将代码、视频和动作作为耦合生成流，代码专家生成可复用技能，视频与动作专家生成预测与指令。
构建自动标注流水线生成对齐程序与技能库，实验表明该框架在机器人任务上优于VLA和WAM基线，提升了推理与鲁棒性。

title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 多模态推理的最小编辑同策略蒸馏方法
abstract: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.
summary_zh: VLM因误读图表导致推理失败，小模型感知瓶颈更突出，而准确文本描述可缩小与大模型差距。
提出最小编辑纠正同策略蒸馏，仅对教师不偏好的错误token计算纠正损失，正确rollout使用任务奖励RL，避免全响应模仿。
该方法测试时无需描述即达到甚至超越提供参考描述的基线，提升几何感知能力并泛化至外部基准，且在冻结同尺寸教师下仍有效。

title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
title_zh: LongZero：从零数据增强LLM长上下文推理
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
summary_zh: 现有RL增强LLM长上下文推理依赖昂贵标注或外部数据，且零数据RL仅适用于短上下文。
提出LongZero，让LLM先合成紧凑结构化问答与证据，再独立扩展为长多文档上下文，结合GRPO训练。
在五个基准上，LongZero泛化至真实任务并超越外部数据基线，为LLM长上下文推理提供可行路径。
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/zhennan1/LongZero

title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
title_zh: 序列推荐中基于物品的自适应递归推理方法
abstract: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.
summary_zh: 现有序列推荐为所有物品分配固定计算量，导致已收敛物品浪费算力且牺牲整体效果。
提出LoopRec，通过轻量级门控独立决定每个物品的递归退出或继续，实现物品级自适应深度推理。
实验表明LoopRec持续优于固定深度基线，且低频与近期交互物品自然获得更深计算，模式可解释。

title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
title_zh: VoxProg：基于体素编程的3D空间推理
abstract: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.
summary_zh: 3D空间推理中语言隐含几何参照，提出VoxProg将物体放置转化为体素编程问题。
语言模型生成程序在局部体素视图上执行，直接从网格提取区域并计算目标SE(3)位姿。
构建71任务VoxProg-Bench及评估套件，VoxProg在多项基准上持续优于各类基线。

title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
title_zh: 环境对决：大语言模型协同演化的微观世界
abstract: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.
summary_zh: 前沿LLM相互吸收产出，需评估其作为创造者与解决者的能力，故提出动态智能体基准Environment Duels。
模型交替编写带提示的环境并求解，发现求解与创作是独立技能，小模型更擅长编写高难度环境与提示。
模型间交互呈现传递性排名与设计趋同，且提示增益能预测RL训练收益，为理解LLM协同演化提供窗口。

title: The End of Consensus Research?
title_zh: AI辅助发现新型共识协议A-greement
abstract: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base, (2) a modular implementation skeleton, and (3) a Lean-based verification framework with reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proofs. AI-greement is of independent interest: its Lean formalization uncovers several previously unreported vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols, and it provides guidelines on how domain-specific harnesses can turn general-purpose coding agents into effective tools for (distributed) computing research. Yet we argue that human consensus experts remain essential before, during, and after the search: agents reshape the researcher's role rather than end consensus research.
summary_zh: 分布式共识低延迟方案设计复杂，需结合多环节推理与验证，传统人工研究进展缓慢。
提出AI-greement智能体框架，集成知识库、模块化骨架与Lean验证，自主发现并验证协议。
发现A-greement协议，在读写密集负载下延迟最高降低33.3%，且Lean验证揭露了已有协议漏洞。

title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
title_zh: Quant-Arena：面向量化交易研究的LLM智能体基准
abstract: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
summary_zh: 现有基准仅评估公式或代码，未验证LLM能否完成量化研究的完整闭环并产出样本外策略。
提出Quant-Arena基准，要求模型在真实A股数据上构建特征与选股代码，仅获2022-2023年反馈，并在封闭的2024年冻结策略评估。
评估9个前沿模型，最高分的GPT-6 Astra亦未在2024年跑赢等权市场，揭示当前LLM在实盘量化交易中的局限。

title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
title_zh: 多模态具身智能体：从计算机到机器人的统一能力视角
abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
summary_zh: 为探究多模态智能体从计算机走向机器人时的变化，提出多模态具身智能体（MMEA）概念，将多模态推理与物理动作及反馈耦合。
提出以功能而非架构定义的 PAPAV 统一框架，包含感知、预测、规划、行动和验证五项核心能力，用于对比分析不同系统。
揭示具身场景存在五大物理约束导致容错极低，且现有基准测试偏重行动而忽视预测与验证，为设计可靠物理智能体提供新依据。

title: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
title_zh: 对抗多智能体重写构建P与NPC配对基准测试LLM
abstract: Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.
summary_zh: 现有基准无法区分模型是推理还是回忆，需构建P与NPC配对问题基准以测试LLM推理能力。
提出P2NPCBench基准，并用AgentGAN对抗重写问题，消除教材线索同时保持答案与复杂性不变。
实验表明LLM在NPC问题表现远差于P配对，且增加时间无济于事，证实失败源于错误程序而非超时。

title: Circuits of LLM Classifiers
title_zh: LLM分类器的电路组合方法
abstract: Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify. However, their predictions are neither deterministic nor uniformly reliable across samples. How can we combine predictions from different models to improve reliability? We view LLM classifiers as noisy measurement instruments of an underlying target label. Our goal is to maximize average classification accuracy at a given average query cost. To this end, we introduce circuits that organize LLM classifiers into an adaptive sequence of queries and decisions. We then characterize the optimal circuit, obtain the fundamental limits of achievable accuracy, and provide practical insights on realizing the optimal circuit. Across seven classification tasks spanning safety, health, political science, human preference, agent evaluation, decision-making and reasoning, our method improves the cost-accuracy frontier over routing and cascading baselines.
summary_zh: LLM分类器预测不确定且可靠性不一，需组合多模型预测以提升可靠性。
将LLM分类器视为目标标签的噪声测量仪器，引入电路将其组织为自适应查询与决策序列。
刻画了最优电路并给出精度极限，在七项任务上显著提升成本-精度前沿。

title: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization
title_zh: 基于图结构分布式块优化的并行AI智能体协作
abstract: Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly. A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a $1/χ_f(G)$ fraction of the total verified local improvement, where $χ_f(G)$ is the graph's fractional chromatic number. This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals. Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap. The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost, yielding a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time-cost trade-off. Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail. On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost. On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs. For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.
summary_zh: 并行AI智能体合并局部编辑会降低共享解，本文将其建模为带依赖图的离散块优化问题。
提出基于独立集的兼容编辑合并方法，证明最优分数着色能保留总局部改进的1/χ_f(G)比例，且保证紧致。
在特定条件下该方法几何收敛，分离了任务结构与计算成本；实验验证了其在代码修复与路径搜索中解决冲突及降低耗时的有效性。

title: Charts as Epistemic Actions for Experience-Driven Agentic Data Analysis
title_zh: 图表作为经验驱动数据分析智能体的认知动作
abstract: Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.
summary_zh: 现有数据智能体推理依赖文本，忽略图表对趋势和异常的视觉揭示，需探索图表作为推理环内部认知动作的可行性。
构建PROBE测试套件发现，智能体虽能读懂自生成图表，但不会主动使用；图表在时序与异常推理上占优，文本在精确读取上领先。
提出METHOD方法，提炼操作选择与模态调用两类经验，经验证门筛选后注入智能体，在不修改模型参数下提升了分析准确率并促使智能体主动用图。

title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 循环均匀扩散语言模型
abstract: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.
summary_zh: 均匀扩散语言模型(UDLM)训练需处理不可靠上下文，虽计算开销大但推理性能更强。
在UDLM中引入选择性循环机制，递归应用早期Transformer层，显著提升训练效率。
循环UDLM以最高3.3倍少的FLOPs达到同等验证NLL，生成困惑度降低9.8%，且调整循环分布可减少12%推理循环。

title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
title_zh: 从推理到行动：前沿AI模型在LIBERO-10机器人操作任务上的评测
abstract: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.
summary_zh: 前沿AI模型缺乏在标准化机器人基准上的系统评估，本文提出统一闭环框架评测其在LIBERO-10上的操作能力。
该框架让模型通过视觉观测和结构化工具调用直接控制机器人，无需任务特定微调或预训练操作技能。
评测显示GPT-6 Astra成功率最高达44%；增加推理努力通常提升性能但增加推理成本，且模型在复杂交互上仍表现挣扎。
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. May Espinola and Qifan Zhang contributed equally. Project page: https://irvlutd.github.io/LLM-LIBERO/ Code: https://github.com/IRVLUTD/LLM_LIBERO

title: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
title_zh: SWE-DIVE：基于动态用户模拟的多轮编程Agent评估
abstract: Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill. To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. We also introduce a conversation validator that evaluates the user simulator's outputs to determine whether they fulfill the initial requirements and guide the agent toward successfully solving the task. The entire framework is embedded in a Harbor environment, which orchestrates the coding agent, user simulator, and conversation validator, and executes the test environment to determine whether the agent successfully solves the task. Our results and source code are available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim).
summary_zh: 现有编程Agent评估多基于单轮且结构良好的提示，但真实场景需求常不明确且需多轮交互。
提出SWE-DIVE框架，引入用户模拟器模拟不同行为模式与Agent进行多轮交互。
设计对话验证器评估需求满足情况，结合Harbor环境编排组件并执行测试，实现多轮动态评估。
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "Grounded User Simulation for Model Evaluation and Training: Diversity, Fidelity, and Validity'' (non-archival)

title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
title_zh: HGM-Dual：面向长程规划的谱系感知引导Agent优化
abstract: Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget.
summary_zh: 规划任务中Agent自我改进常探索无效变更并消耗大量评估预算，需提升优化效率。
提出HGM-Dual框架，用谱系感知上下文记录祖先变更与结果归因，并基于错误条件生成通用与特化子代。
该方法在案例准确率上最高提升14.45%，且以2至4倍更少的评估预算达到基线最优性能。

title: Robust Soft Skill Adaptation via Behavioral Localization in Tool-Using Agents
title_zh: 基于行为定位的工具使用Agent软技能自适应
abstract: Text skills can extend the capabilities of tool-using agents, but long skill descriptions increase computational costs. Soft prompts provide a compact alternative, yet learning from entire successful trajectories may also introduce unnecessary behavioral changes. We find that the useful effect of a text skill is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which compares the frozen agent with and without the text skill to identify positions where the skill both increases the likelihood of successful tokens and meaningfully changes the next token distribution. We use these localized positions to supervise a short soft prompt. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that the top 10\% of trajectory positions capture 96.12\% of the total positive skill gain. In the shared prompt setting, selective supervision improves success from 30.36\% with full trajectory to 36.79\%. Under task-specific conditions, using the top 10\% localized positions achieves 57.38\%, outperforming both the full text skill and the on-policy OPCD baseline. These results show that a small set of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions can provide effective supervision of soft skills.
summary_zh: 长文本技能描述增加计算开销，且从完整成功轨迹学习软提示会引入不必要的行为改变。
提出行为定位法，对比冻结Agent有无文本技能的差异，定位使成功概率增加且改变分布的关键轨迹位置，以此监督短软提示。
实验表明仅用前10%定位位置即可捕获96.12%正向增益，任务特定下成功率57.38%，优于全文本技能及基线方法。

title: Modeling QNMs-Filtered Gravitational Waveforms: Approximation Limits and Filtering Effects
title_zh: 拟简正模式滤波后的引力波形建模：近似极限与滤波效应
abstract: The waveform left after quasinormal modes filtering of binary gravitational waveforms, often called the direct wave, has recently attracted considerable debate.
