Analytic models of this residual waveform involve several levels of approximation, while the effects of filtering on the modeling remain unclear. These issues require further investigation. In this paper, we examine the approximation errors, limits of applicability, and role of filtering in these models. We find that the point-particle models examined here show notable discrepancies with the filtered Binary-black-hole waveforms. Analytic particle templates based on the stationary-phase approximation perform reasonably well for the \((\ell,m)=(2,2)\) multipole, but exhibit substantial limitations for the \((4,4)\). Although the filter is all-pass, it substantially affects the modeling results. Our analytic calculations on a Schwarzschild background further show that vacuum perturbations with Gaussian initial data can also exhibit direct-wave-like waveforms after filtering, with their morphology depending on the location of the initial data relative to the light ring.
summary_zh: 拟简正模式滤波后的残余波形（直接波）解析模型存在多层近似，且滤波对建模的影响尚不明确。
本文评估了点粒子模型与滤波后双黑洞波形的误差，发现该模型对(2,2)极点表现尚可，但对(4,4)极点存在严重局限。
研究表明全通滤波器仍显著影响建模结果；Schwarzschild背景下的真空微扰经滤波后也会呈现直接波形态。

title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
title_zh: 企业文档摄入中的静默线索丢失问题
abstract: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.
summary_zh: 企业文档摄入时主流转换器丢失作者编码的视觉格式线索，导致 agent 自信地给出错误答案。
基于76份真实策略文档构建任务，发现忽略格式使F1大幅下降，高亮和颜色是关键线索。
32.8%的文档含颜色或高亮，主动为 agent 输入线索比仅保留格式效果更佳，纯文本能力有限。

title: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
title_zh: 面向大型代码库的层次化文档与跨模态检索框架
abstract: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining (i) CodeGraph, a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries. Evaluation on OpenCV and a proprietary 5M-LOC repository shows that CodeScribe-derived supervision significantly improves cross-modal retrieval in text-to-code accuracy over baseline approaches. Richer textual supervision (hierarchical documentation, parent/sibling context, and LLM-generated synthetic questions) consistently enhances performance across both repositories. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using the popular RAGAS of the Code Comprehensor output yields above 90% faithfulness scores.
summary_zh: 大型代码库理解难且LLM缺乏全局上下文，提出混合检索推理框架Code Comprehensor，显著提升代码理解与查询能力。
利用代码调用图与LLM生成层次化文档，并训练CLIP式双编码器CodeContrast，实现快速精准的文本到代码跨模态检索。
在OpenCV等代码库评估表明，层次化文本监督提升跨模态检索准确率，RAGAS评估显示输出忠实度超90%。
comment: Accepted at 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution

title: Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do, Without Running Them
title_zh: 智能体行为图：基于行为定位智能体而无需运行
abstract: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.
summary_zh: 问题：成功率相似的 LLM agent 可能遵循不同动作序列，难以仅凭成功率区分行为差异。
方法：提出 Agent Behavior Map，利用共享参考轨迹上的中心化动作对数似然表示 LLM-harness 组合，无需目标 agent 的新环境 rollout。
结论：该方法推导出坐标距离与轨迹 KL 散度的误差界，在 100 个 LLM 与 4 个环境中有效预测性能并识别行为相似性。

title: Seeking Cost--Effective Incentive for Merchant MTDC Investment in an AC Grid: A Parametric MISOCP Model to VSC Siting and Sizing
title_zh: 交流电网中商户MTDC投资的经济激励：VSC选址定容参数化MISOCP模型
abstract: Deploying voltage source converter (VSC)-based multi-terminal DC (MTDC) networks in existing AC grids offers a promising solution for alleviating transmission congestion, enhancing power-transfer capability, and improving operational economy. However, constructing an MTDC network requires participation from merchant investors. Therefore, the transmission system operator (TSO) responsible for the AC grid must provide an adequate economic incentive that enables merchant investors not only to recover the MTDC investment cost but also to earn a reasonable return commensurate with their risk and expectations. An insufficient incentive may fail to attract merchant investment, whereas an excessive incentive may unnecessarily reduce the economic benefits retained by the TSO. Determining an appropriate incentive that balances these competing interests therefore becomes a critical issue. To address this issue, this paper formulates a sharing-rate-parameterized mixed-integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) model that jointly optimizes VSC siting and sizing while coordinating AC/DC system operation. A straightforward search procedure is then employed to identify the benefit-sharing rate that meets the investor's expectations while preserving sufficient benefits for the TSO. Case studies demonstrate the operating-cost benefits of MTDC integration and validate the proposed search strategy for seeking such a benefit-sharing rate.
summary_zh: 在交流电网中部署MTDC可缓解阻塞并提升经济性，但需商户投资，TSO需提供合理激励以平衡双方利益。
提出一种基于分摊率参数化的MISOCP模型，联合优化VSC选址定容并协调交直流系统运行。
通过搜索程序确定满足投资方预期且保留TSO足够收益的分摊率，算例验证了该策略的有效性。

title: Agentic Architecture of Information Systems. The AAM/5C Model: A Reference Model for Distributed Autonomy
title_zh: 信息系统代理架构：分布式自治参考模型AAM/5C
abstract: Large organizations increasingly face what this book calls the cognitive complexity wall: at the scale of hundreds of interacting components, maintaining the dependency map and reacting at the pace of incidents exceeds what a human team can deliver. This conceptual volume proposes AAM/5C, in which five capabilities (Capture, Comprehend, Choose, Coordinate, Control) are instantiated across seven logical layers, L1 to L7. A single authorization rule, R-AUT, separates who proposes, who decides and who executes: a probabilistic planner (L4) proposes; a governance layer (L6) decides under signed policies and records its verdict in a signed evaluation proof; a security layer (L5) issues a short-lived act token bound to that proof; a policy enforcement point verifies both before the target layer materializes the act. Under an explicit guarantee contract, two analytical statements (H7a, H8a) hold by construction. The other statements of its ten hypotheses (H1 to H10), including log completeness (H7b) and non-bypass of the enforcement point (H8b), are refutable, and the protocol that could refute them is fixed before any measurement. The contribution of the book is a prescriptive reference model that articulates, under this single authorization rule, known mechanisms and adds three constructs, all to be validated: the Validation step of the Distributed Autonomy Loop, the ephemeral authority surface and the cognitive dependency plane. The book positions them against autonomic computing, multi-agent systems, enterprise architecture and agent protocols (MCP, A2A), gives an authorization policy in Rego and a partial TLA+ specification of peer consensus, and sets out a validation program with quantified milestones. It reports no empirical results. This English edition is a translation of the French original, produced with the assistance of AI tools and validated by the author.
summary_zh: 大型组织面临认知复杂性墙，人类团队难以维护组件依赖并响应事件，需分布式自治。
提出AAM/5C模型，将5C能力分布于L1-L7层，由R-AUT规则分离提议、决策与执行。
贡献为规定性参考模型，引入分布式自治循环验证等三个新构造，并给出量化验证计划。
comment: 120 pages, 19 figures, 15 tables, 3 listings. Conceptual volume. English translation of the French original (version V7.83; HAL: hal-05820640; Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23494375). This English edition is also on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23494664

title: EPIC: Rethinking Trust Regions for Autoregressive LLM Policies via Exact-KL Prefix Importance-Ratio Clipping
title_zh: EPIC：基于精确KL前缀重要性比率裁剪的LLM信任域优化
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) based on PPO-style clipping has become an effective approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, standard token-level clipping measures policy change only through the conditional probability of the current token, while the prefix conditioning context is itself generated by the policy. This mismatch becomes especially consequential in long-response and off-policy training. We reformulate autoregressive generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and derive its performance-difference identity under behavior-policy sampling. The resulting change of measure identifies the cumulative likelihood ratio of the generated prefix as the exact importance weight for each stepwise policy-improvement term. Starting from the monotonic-improvement principle of trust-region policy optimization, we then construct a prefix-level trust region using the exact reverse-KL coordinate $r-1-\log r$, whose behavior-policy expectation equals the corresponding prefix-distribution KL divergence. This yields EPIC, a PPO-style sequence-clipping method that directly regulates prefix-level policy drift without relying on a local quadratic approximation or expert-routing replay. Experiments on off-policy reinforcement learning with a sparse mixture-of-experts language model show that EPIC consistently outperforms standard and sequence-level clipping baselines across mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, while remaining competitive with routing-replay-based alternatives. Code is available at https://github.com/LiChengxi666/EPIC.
summary_zh: 标准PPO逐词裁剪忽略前缀由策略生成的事实，导致长文本与离轨训练失配。
将自回归生成重构为有限MDP，推导出前缀累积似然比为策略改进的精确重要性权重。
提出EPIC算法，用精确反向KL构建前缀级信任域，在离轨稀疏MoE实验中优于基线。

title: HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements
title_zh: HiddenLens：检测与解决软件需求中隐藏假设的多层LLM框架
abstract: Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalability, usability, reliability, and domain; Layer 4 generates ranked clarification options using FS LLM prompting; Layer 5 enables human validation through confirmation, editing, or rephrasing; and Layer 6 rewrites the requirement using the confirmed resolution, producing an explicit, testable, and traceable requirement. We also introduce the HiddenLens Corpus (HLC), comprising 312 requirements annotated with 847 hidden assumptions across six NFR categories. Inspired by PROMISE and PURE, HLC addresses the lack of annotated data for this task and is, to our knowledge, the first dataset developed specifically for it. HiddenLens outperforms keyword-based and QuARS-Adapted baselines by 71% and 61%, respectively, achieving an end-to-end F1-score of 0.79; its BERT-based NFR classifier achieves an F1-score of 0.847. These results indicate that HiddenLens can help analysts resolve hidden assumptions before they propagate through software development.
summary_zh: 软件需求常遗漏性能等假设，若实现期才发现修复成本极高，现有研究多关注歧义而非看似合理需求中的隐藏假设。
提出HiddenLens六层BERT-LLM框架，依次实现定位未解析片段、推理假设风险、分类非功能需求、生成澄清选项、人工验证及重写需求。
构建含312条需求与847个假设的HLC语料库；模型端到端F1达0.79，NFR分类F1达0.847，显著优于基线方法。

title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
title_zh: 保持溯源的多模态超图记忆机制
abstract: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 多模态 agent 长期记忆难以兼顾保留细粒度视觉证据与追踪实体跨会话演化，现有方法易丢失视觉细节或难以关联实体身份。
提出 MHG-Mem 多模态超图记忆，将实体身份、状态演化与视觉证据联合组织，通过超边分组一致实体并合成演化状态。
引入超图 agent 搜索机制自适应遍历记忆层级，支持细粒度视觉验证与跨会话推理，实验显示性能较最强基线提升 8.20-9.98%。

title: TIDE: Tree-Induced Fine-Grained Diagnostic Evaluation from Model Behaviors
title_zh: TIDE：基于树诱导的模型行为细粒度诊断评估
abstract: Benchmark performance is the dominant standard for comparing large language models (LLMs), typically summarized by a single aggregate score, such as accuracy, pass rate, or rubric score. This aggregate score provides limited information about a model's underlying capabilities, yet understanding these capabilities is crucial for model development and evaluation. To this end, we propose Tree-Induced Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), which recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction to perform fine-grained capability diagnosis. TIDE recursively builds a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores: at each node, an LLM judge proposes candidate splits and performs sample-to-group classification, and behavior-based information gain selects among them. We apply TIDE to five models across four benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness, and find fine-grained capability contrasts invisible at the aggregate level: Claude Opus 4.6 achieves 100% on microeconomic market reasoning where GPT-5.4 scores 83.3%, but trails GPT-5.4 on contract law reasoning with 77.8% versus 88.9%. We hope TIDE can be extended to past and future benchmarks so that the rich behavioral signal in evaluation results is fully leveraged for understanding model capabilities.
summary_zh: 传统基准测试的单一总分无法揭示LLM的底层能力，难以满足模型开发与评估的细粒度理解需求。
提出TIDE方法，将诊断评估转化为行为驱动的决策树归纳，利用LLM judge分类与信息增益递归构建能力树。
实验发现TIDE能揭示总分掩盖的细粒度能力差异，如Claude Opus与GPT-5.4在微观经济与合同法律推理上的表现反转。

title: Lax descent and foliated Verdier duality
title_zh: Lax下降与叶状Verdier对偶
abstract: Higher categorical methods allow us to view recollements as lax descent data and build a corresponding descent theory governed by an $\infty$-bicategorical theory of limits. We demonstrate some concrete innovations brought along by these new techniques in the classical context of constructible and perverse sheaves on stratified spaces. Our first application uses partially (op)lax descent to recover the famous result of Beilinson telling us how to glue perverse sheaves in terms of vanishing and nearby cycles. The remainder of the article is concerened with establishing a uniform view on a series of classification results for perverse sheaves culminating in recent work of Kapranov-Schechtman. Namely, we use lax descent to establish a ``foliated'' variant of Verdier duality which, informally speaking, identifies the derived constructible category of a suitably foliated space with sections of a categorical cosheaf on the leaf space whose stalks are the categories of sheaves along the leaves. Again, this is obtained as an application of lax descent, and seems to provide a reasonable framework to formalize the idea of ``mixed sheaf-cosheaf objects'' promoted by Kapranov and Schechtman.
summary_zh: 【问题】需在高阶范畴下统一重构分层空间上可构造层与反常层的理论；【方法】将重组视为lax下降数据并构建∞-双范畴极限下降理论；【结论】为经典层理论提供了新的高阶范畴技术。
【问题】需从下降理论视角理解Beilinson关于反常层粘合的经典结论；【方法】利用部分(op)lax下降技术；【结论】成功复原了用消失圈与邻近圈粘合反常层的结果。
【问题】需统一反常层的一系列分类结果并形式化“混合层-余层对象”；【方法】应用lax下降建立叶状Verdier对偶变体；【结论】将叶状空间的导出可构造范畴等同于叶空间上范畴余层的截面，为混合对象提供合理框架。

title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
title_zh: CulturalRiddles：跨文化谜语基准测试
abstract: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.
summary_zh: 现有基准多英语中心且偏事实知识，缺乏真实文化语境应用，提出CulturalRiddles基准。
通过众包构建涵盖62种文化、51种语言的谜语，需溯因推理、社会知识及文化联想。
对28种LLM评估，前沿模型在部分社区准确率至多22%，并开源数据与贡献流程。

title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
title_zh: ToM2Vec：面向多智能体协作的连续心智理论词元
abstract: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.
summary_zh: LLM智能体难以在文本空间中表示多智能体交互的不确定性，易局限于单一伙伴状态。
提出ToM2Vec，通过连续推理词元在隐空间学习抽象心智理论，并以伙伴真实想法为监督进行训练。
实验表明该方法在多种场景下显著提升协作表现，且泛化至未见模型；隐词元编码了心智理论而非任务信息。

title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: 结合图拓扑与能量驱动寻径的上下文一致性RAG框架
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 现有RAG在多跳问答中存在语义损失和模态失配问题，导致上下文细节丢失且与LLM预训练数据不兼容。
提出ThreadRAG框架，通过语义拓扑映射器构建保留上下文的语义拓扑图，并用能量驱动寻径提取子图。
将子图线性化为连贯文本证据，在多跳QA基准上显著超越基线，且token成本降至最强基线的23.3%。
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026

title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries
title_zh: JANUS：面向Android原生库的智能体跨语言模糊测试Harness生成
abstract: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods. In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. JANUS iteratively resolves both explicit and implicit cross-language call dependencies to recover app-specific runtime context, and recursively assembles cross-language argument objects in a bottom-up manner. JANUS leverages an autonomous agentic workflow to reduce reliance on hand-crafted heuristics, capturing the vast landscape of hidden API usage knowledge embedded in closed-source native libraries. Evaluation on 44 popular real-world apps (such as Google and YouTube Music, covering 21,386 JNI methods total) shows that JANUS produces over 5.9 times as many valid harnesses (6,094) as state-of-the-art automatic harnessing tools. On pre-installed apps from five mainstream Android vendors (e.g., Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), JANUS further uncovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries.
summary_zh: Android跨语言交互将安全运行时暴露于不安全的C/C++，现有模糊测试难以精准捕获闭源跨语言API用法。
提出JANUS，首个基于智能体的跨语言JNI感知Harness生成方法，迭代解析跨语言调用依赖并自底向上组装参数对象。
在44款真实应用上评估，JANUS生成的有效Harness数量达现有工具5.9倍，并在主流厂商预装应用中发现6个未知漏洞。
comment: Harness Generation, Android Native Libraries, LLM Agent

title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
title_zh: FrontierCS 2：面向计算机科学研发的基准测试
abstract: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference. The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics. Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future. We evaluate 12 agents. The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs. No run passes on 16 tasks. A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some metric or workload. On a shared capability scale for agents and tasks, the median task is roughly as difficult as what the strongest agent can handle.
summary_zh: 为评估 LLM agent 在前沿计算机科学研发中的能力，提出 FrontierCS 2 基准，包含 48 个开放任务。
该基准将 agent 置于真实研究环境中，继承代码库并提交补丁，通过私有测试集与人类参考代码对比评分。
对 12 个 agent 的评估显示，最佳模型通过率仅 58%，多数超越参考分数的运行仍存在指标短板。

title: Privacy Preference Controls for Agentic Systems
title_zh: 智能体系统的隐私偏好控制
abstract: In response to vast and widespread online tracking, regulators and technologists alike have worked to develop laws and tools that allow people to express their privacy preferences. These measures seek to offer users greater control over the sale and sharing of personal information, putting agency in their hands to protect their privacy. However, the web is undergoing a seismic shift, away from strictly user-driven behavior towards agentic behavior, where AI agents take autonomous actions on behalf of users. In this study, we ask: What should privacy preference controls look like in the agentic web and agentic systems more generally? To answer this question, we develop a taxonomy of enforceable privacy preferences for agentic systems. Our taxonomy is informed both by laws and empirical studies of existing privacy tools as well as an audit of 30 leading AI assistants and agent platforms. To explore how our taxonomy can be implemented, we design and develop eight open-source prototypes that mirror real-world agentic applications and demonstrate how major aspects of our taxonomy can be structurally integrated in agentic protocols, such as the Model Control Protocol and Agent2Agent protocol. Ultimately, our study seeks to provide the groundwork for ensuring end-user privacy and autonomy is not lost in the newly arriving agentic world.
summary_zh: 现有隐私控制工具针对用户驱动行为，难以应对AI智能体自主行动带来的隐私挑战。
结合法律、实证研究及对30个主流AI平台的审计，构建了智能体系统可执行的隐私偏好分类体系。
开发8个开源原型，将该分类体系集成至MCP等智能体协议中，为保障用户隐私奠定基础。

title: Lean-QuantumAlg: A Framework for AI Agents to Produce Quantum Algorithms that Humans Can Trust
title_zh: Lean-QuantumAlg：构建人类可信赖量子算法的AI智能体框架
abstract: AI agents are increasingly capable of constructing quantum algorithms and proofs, yet machine-checked proofs alone cannot guarantee that the intended problem is solved or that resource claims match the verified computation.Here we introduce Lean-QuantumAlg, a Lean 4 framework for trustworthy AI-assisted development of quantum algorithms.Its Algorithm-Solves-Problem contract binds correctness, success probability, borrowed-state restoration and quantum and classical resource bounds to a single execution, while separating the guarantees that Lean checks from the problem specifications and execution models that humans review. We demonstrate the framework on nine AI-formalized quantum algorithms, from Grover search to quantum attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256, with less than 1% of each algorithm's imported source code requiring statement-level human review once the shared framework has been audited. By integrating reusable mathematical foundations, certified algorithmic primitives and execution-grounded verification, Lean-QuantumAlg provides a basis for AI agents to construct and certify quantum algorithms, opening a path toward scalable AI-driven discovery of quantum algorithms.
summary_zh: 现有AI生成的量子算法证明无法保证解决预期问题或资源声明准确，需提升其可信度。
提出Lean-QuantumAlg框架，通过Algorithm-Solves-Problem契约绑定正确性与资源界限，分离机器验证与人工审查。
在9个AI形式化量子算法上验证，仅需审核不到1%的导入代码，为可扩展的AI驱动量子算法发现奠定基础。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
title_zh: 大语言模型检测语码转换讽刺句的基准评测
abstract: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.
summary_zh: 罗马尼亚语等低资源语言中，语码转换对讽刺检测等高级推理任务的影响尚未充分探索，LLM难以捕捉其文化与句法线索。
采用随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析和LLM四种方法生成语码混合句，构建了含60万样本的CS-SeLeRoSa数据集及黄金标准测试集。
评测多语言LLM发现：旧模型性能大幅下降，而Gemma 4 31B微调后在黄金标准上达72.6%，超越前沿模型的零样本基线。

title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
title_zh: AI Mindmeld：一种潜空间互联协议
abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld
summary_zh: LLM与专家模型间通过文本等多模态交互存在瓶颈，提出直接交换高维表征的潜空间互联协议（LIP）。
LIP仅训练连接器将专家表征映射至LLM内部状态，无需联合训练，且随LLM演进保持实用性。
实验证明独立训练的连接器能支持新任务并实现零样本跨域迁移，但当前LLM原生处理该输入与推理的能力仍受限。

title: DynaCI: Generating GitHub Actions Workflows via Dynamic Analysis
title_zh: DynaCI：基于动态分析生成GitHub Actions工作流
abstract: Continuous Integration (CI) is an essential practice that automatically validates code changes through builds and tests. However, configuring CI workflows remains challenging, as modern software often features complex architectures, numerous dependencies, and support for diverse execution environments. Most CI platforms also require workflows to be written in their particular domain-specific languages. As a result, CI workflows are often error-prone and hard to maintain, especially for those unfamiliar with CI semantics. Prior work on automated CI workflow generation require developers to create specifications that describe their intended workflows using natural language, partial workflows, etc. However, in practice, developers may struggle to articulate requirements and may be unaware of available CI features. To address these limitations, we propose DynaCI, a novel approach that uses runtime information from developers' local environments to generate CI workflows. DynaCI (i) traces the developers' local environment to collect runtime information, (ii) constructs an initial workflow by applying runtime-informed heuristics, and (iii) iteratively refines the workflow via LLM-based Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). We evaluate DynaCI on 50 popular Python projects that use GitHub Actions, a popular CI platform, and compare it against the state-of-the-art CI workflow generation approaches: GH-WCOM and LLM4GW. DynaCI outperforms these existing approaches by more than 21.13% in BLEU score and 20.96% in F1 score on average. It also generates workflows without missing functionality in 56% of cases, while requiring fewer manual modifications to repair such exceptions. These results demonstrate that leveraging runtime information substantially improves LLM-based CI workflow generation, and offer a promising direction for broader DevOps configuration automation.
summary_zh: CI工作流配置易错且难维护，现有自动生成方法需开发者提供明确规范，但开发者常难以表达需求或不知晓可用CI特性。
提出DynaCI方法，利用本地环境运行时信息生成CI工作流，结合运行时启发式规则构建初始工作流，并经LLM与RAG迭代优化。
在50个Python项目上评估，DynaCI的BLEU和F1分数平均超现有方法21.13%和20.96%，56%的生成结果无功能缺失，证明运行时信息显著提升生成效果。

title: On the notion of reasonable functions in Cohen--Lenstra type heuristics
title_zh: Cohen-Lenstra型启发式中合理函数的概念研究
abstract: We elucidate the notion of "reasonable functions" in the context of Cohen--Lenstra heuristics. For a sequence $(x_i)_i$ of independent random variables valued in an infinite discrete probability space $(X,p)$, we investigate for what sets $S$ of functions on $X$ it is true that almost surely, for all $f\in S$, the average of $f$ on the sequence is equal to its expected value. We show that if $p$ decays sufficiently quickly, as e.g. the Cohen--Lenstra distribution does, then $\bigcup_{q>1}L^q(X)$ is such a set; while if $p$ decays sufficiently slowly, then not even $\bigcap_{q<\infty}L^q(X)$ has this property.
summary_zh: 【问题】Cohen-Lenstra启发式中“合理函数”的概念尚不明确，需探究何种函数集能使大数定律成立。
【方法】研究无限离散概率空间上独立随机变量序列，分析函数平均值等于期望值的条件。
【结论】概率衰减快时L^q空间并集满足该性质；衰减慢时L^q空间交集也不满足。

title: PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit
title_zh: PAUSE：代码智能体首次编辑前的无搜索引导框架
abstract: Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies online, during a live run, and offline, from a recorded trajectory prefix. We evaluate PAUSE on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual with two Executors and three agent harnesses. With Qwen3-coder as Executor and GPT-5.6 Sol as Planner, online steering improves resolution by 16.8% on Verified in OpenHands and by 14.7% on Multilingual in SWE-agent. In SWE-agent, PAUSE outperforms LivePlan, a rule-triggered advisor, by 3.2% on Verified and 3.7% on Multilingual at similar Planner cost, and is comparable to SICA's periodic overseer at about 11-15% of its Planner cost. Offline, PAUSE recovers 35.4% of eligible failed Verified tasks, and resuming from the recorded prefix uses 33-41% fewer Executor tokens than restarting.
summary_zh: 代码智能体常因探索和测试不足生成无效补丁，现有在线引导方法需频繁审查或异常监控，成本高且易漏判方向偏差。
提出PAUSE框架，在智能体首次源码编辑前拦截，由Planner生成修复计划并交由原智能体继续执行，无需搜索或额外模型调用。
在SWE-bench上在线引导提升解决率最高16.8%，成本远低于SICA；离线模式可挽回35.4%失败任务且节省33-41%执行Token。

title: Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents
title_zh: 上下文压缩编码代理的来源破坏与清洗攻击
abstract: Coding agents that run long enough must compact their context, summarizing the conversation, discarding the original, and carrying the summary forward as memory. We show that in popular open-source coding agents this step is an exploitable trust boundary. Harnesses that flatten the typed conversation into a single plain string, marking each message with a text label such as [User]:, destroy message provenance in code, before the summarizer runs. An attacker who controls anything the agent reads can forge a user turn that survives compaction as a genuine instruction. Across five flattening harnesses (pi, opencode, Cline, Aider, OpenHands) the forged approval launders into the agent's memory 87-100% of the time, up to a ~908,000-token context window; across four role-typed harnesses (Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Continue) the identical attack succeeds 0% of the time. We follow the attack to executed consequences. A laundered standing approval drives real tool-running agents to execute attacker-controlled curl | sh in a sandbox, and end to end in the live pi TUI at ~50% against a 0% paired clean arm. The same channel reliably steers an agent's plan away from a file an attacker designates off-limits, which can blind a code review to a planted backdoor. Because the provenance is destroyed deterministically in harness code, no prompt-level defense can restore it; we measure a code-level provenance check that catches 77% of laundering while demoting 2% of legitimate summary content. The defect also has a straightforward fix at the serializer, escaping the role labels before flattening; the role-typed harnesses avoid it entirely by keeping messages role-typed.
summary_zh: 长时编码代理压缩上下文时，扁平化处理会破坏消息来源，导致攻击者可伪造用户指令。
在5款扁平化工具中，伪造指令87-100%混入记忆，可驱使代理执行恶意代码或绕过审查。
该缺陷无法用提示词防御，需在序列化器转义标签或保持角色类型，代码级检查可拦截77%攻击。
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Source code, raw data, and recorded live demonstrations at https://github.com/pixee/flat-compaction-attacks-oct-2027

title: Automated Discovery of Physically Interpretable Subgrid Length Scales for Detached Eddy Simulation via Agentic AI
title_zh: 基于智能体AI的物理可解释DES次网格长度尺度自动发现
abstract: Traditional turbulence-model development relies heavily on expert knowledge and is time-consuming. This study develops an agentic AI framework, DEScover (automated Discovery of DES closures), to explore subgrid length scales for detached eddy simulation (DES). The user provides only a modeling idea: the length scale is the grid width normal to the local vortex axis. Four large language model (LLM) agents then propose, review, implement, and evaluate candidate formulations and generate scripts for CFD simulations. The Discovery Agent infers the vortex axis from various vortex-identification methods. The candidates are tested on four cases spanning canonical and engineering flows: a flat plate, a backward-facing step, a free shear layer, and an iced airfoil. For all test cases, the best candidate consistently outperforms the standard length scale based on the maximum cell size. Its accuracy is similar to, or slightly better than, that of the expert-designed shear-layer-adapted length scale. Each agentic discovery run takes about 25 minutes on average, excluding the CFD simulations. These results show that LLM-based reasoning can significantly accelerate the discovery of physically interpretable turbulence models and reduce reliance on manual expert formulation.
summary_zh: 传统湍流模型开发耗时且依赖专家知识，需自动化方法提升效率。
提出DEScover智能体AI框架，由LLM智能体提出、审查、实现并评估候选次网格长度尺度公式。
新模型在四类典型与工程流动中均优于标准尺度，且媲美专家设计尺度，单次发现仅需约25分钟。

title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
title_zh: Agent记忆的苦涩教训：记忆税的实证研究
abstract: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.
summary_zh: 针对强模型能否自主搜索而无需设计记忆的问题，对比4种记忆方法与3种coding agent，发现设计记忆是弱模型的昂贵补丁。
为评估记忆系统的成本与效果，在长对话中测试各方法，发现Mem0仅对弱模型有效且构建成本超全上下文，且记忆上限受写入模型限制。
通过实证分析成本与准确率，发现强模型下coding agent Pi达到99%准确率且成本不足全上下文一半，证明自主搜索优于设计记忆。

title: UserSWE: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Conversations with Dynamic Users
title_zh: UserSWE：在多轮对话与动态用户中评估编程智能体
abstract: As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions. Existing benchmarks do not adequately cover this scenario. Most present a complete issue report in a single turn without interaction. Their evaluation can produce both false positives and false negatives, accepting incorrect patches or rejecting correct ones. We introduce UserSWE for evaluating coding agents' ability to fix repository-level bugs through multi-turn interactions with dynamic users and execution-grounded verdicts at every turn. Its construction pipeline turns repository history and existing single-turn benchmarks into multi-turn tasks. At each turn, information pools constrain what the simulated user can reveal, while a persona chain sampled from a transition model calibrated on 20,859 development sessions governs how it speaks. Tests run after every turn, and a pair of agents from different model families writes and gates each verdict, using test results as primary evidence and model judgment only for aspects the tests cannot resolve. We evaluate eleven agents on 72 tasks from 42 repositories and find that agent rankings change with the interaction budget. Claude Fable 5.1 resolves the most tasks in one turn, GPT-6-Astra resolves the most by the eighth turn, and Claude Opus 5 leads at most intermediate budgets. These results indicate that single-turn performance is insufficient to characterize interactive coding ability.
summary_zh: 现有编程智能体基准多为单轮且缺乏交互，易产生误判，无法评估多轮交互修bug能力。
提出UserSWE基准，通过仓库历史构建多轮任务，用校准的转移模型模拟动态用户交互。
采用每轮执行测试并由双智能体门控判决；实验表明单轮性能不足以表征交互编程能力。
评估11个智能体发现排名随交互预算变化，证明多轮交互评估对编程智能体不可或缺。

title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
title_zh: 真实PMID对应错误论文：生物医学声明验证智能体设计
abstract: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.
summary_zh: 针对生物医学声明验证智能体缺乏控制证据的问题，对比四种检索架构，发现让模型自主生成查询的ReAct架构召回率最高且准确率最优。
即使最优检索架构的准确率也仅62%，而提供标准摘要可达79-86%，表明检索而非推理是当前智能体验证能力的主要瓶颈。
闭卷模型常生成真实存在但内容无关的PMID，仅验证ID存在无法保证引用相关性，因此存在性检查不足以作为科学智能体的安全防护。
comment: Accepted to the Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 从欧氏到双曲视觉语言模型：基于基元的组合性统一视角
abstract: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.
summary_zh: 组合零样本学习需识别未见过的属性-对象组合，现有方法依赖显式向量重组来实现泛化。
本文提出新评分函数，证明直接使用分解出的基元即可识别未见组合，无需显式重组。
实验表明组合结构在多种几何流形与模型中均以基元形式涌现，有效提升CZSL推理与群鲁棒性。
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 Main Conference, 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables

title: MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: 检索增强生成中调节搜索动量的宏自适应并行推理
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.
summary_zh: 现有交错推理检索的RAG易产生冗余子查询且探索不足，且推理对查询意图的影响不明。
提出搜索动量概念刻画查询意图演变，发现其易沿历史轨迹持续演化导致意图偏移。
提出MAPS框架，通过保留知识状态与并行推理检索来调节动量，实验证明其优于现有RAG方法。

title: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
title_zh: 面向未来预测的递归自改进智能体系统DeepEvolve
abstract: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challenge for agent evolution. Here we introduce EvoForesight, a sustainable evolution agent system grounded in future event prediction, in which agents continuously interact with a dynamically evolving environment and improve by internalizing and externalizing the experience gained through these interactions. A living environment synthesizes verifiable tasks, and a recursive-evolution engine turns the reasoning trajectory behind each prediction back into capability: decoupling search from prediction adapts parameter-level evolution to the contamination-prone live environment, while distilling reusable skills lets the agent evolve from the limited live trajectories such an environment affords. On the external FutureX leaderboard, which evaluates predictions against real-world outcomes and is updated weekly, our self-improved forecaster ranked first across all systems over three consecutive weeks, achieving up to a 195% improvement in rating. On our synthesized evaluation, it ranked among the top three across four base LLMs, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 10.7 Bradley--Terry points. More broadly, these results suggest that a system built for self-improvement is best understood as an agent that co-evolves with a genuinely living, open-ended environment, pointing to a shift in AI from training static models on fixed data toward cultivating agents that grow stronger from their own experience, with such an open world as the indispensable basis of that growth.
summary_zh: 现有AI系统参数固定，缺乏在持续变化环境中实现递归自改进（RSI）的能力。
提出DeepEvolve系统，通过解耦搜索与预测及蒸馏可复用技能，将预测推理轨迹转化为能力，实现智能体与动态环境的协同进化。
在FutureX真实排行榜连续三周排名第一，评分提升达195%，超越最强基线10.7个BT点，验证了自改进智能体的有效性。

title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
title_zh: UniRAP：面向部件级物理可供性推理与可执行感知的统一模型
abstract: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.
summary_zh: 现有视觉语言模型难以将高层语义映射至部件级物理交互，本文提出统一模型UniRAP解决该问题。
将问题建模为条件多模态生成任务，通过统一接口令牌机制融合多模态输入，并引入统一可供性解码器联合执行检测、分割与4自由度位姿估计。
提出课程式迁移训练策略提升有限标注下的数据效率，实验表明模型在多项任务上达SOTA且保持时空一致性。

title: OMAR: Open-World Multi-Attribute Reasoning for Scene-Conditioned Shelf Organization
title_zh: 面向场景条件化货架组织的开放世界多属性推理
abstract: With the advent of foundation models, robots are increasingly capable of understanding and executing explicitly specified human tasks. Extending these capabilities to open-ended tasks, however, requires robots to infer appropriate actions from the observed scene. Household organization exemplifies this challenge, as robots must often act without detailed instructions, predefined object vocabularies, or known object-receptacle associations. While robots may follow instructions or learn organization preferences from demonstrations, inferring the latent organization of an occasionally changing scene and placing a novel object consistently with it remains challenging. We propose an open-world multi-attribute reasoning pipeline that grounds unknown objects across views and constructs an instance-level 3D scene graph for placement reasoning. First, a vision-language model proposes labels together with attributes such as content and packaging type, which are grounded through segmentation, depth, and multi-view association. Then, an LLM reasons over this representation to infer the latent shelf organization and rank scene-consistent object placements without explicitly user-provided preferences. The resulting placement rankings guide subsequent geometric and kinematic feasibility checks for execution. Our experimental evaluation shows that our approach leads to improved instance mapping and placement coherence over single-view language-grounding and geometry-only baselines, enabling autonomous placement of previously unseen objects without predefined object-receptacle mappings or class-specific retraining.
summary_zh: 机器人在缺乏明确指令和已知关联时，推断场景潜在组织并一致放置新物体仍具挑战。
提出开放世界多属性推理管线，利用VLM跨视角关联物体属性并构建实例级3D场景图。
LLM基于场景图推断潜在组织并排序放置位置，实验表明该方法提升了放置连贯性。

title: Prompt Injection Through Forensic Evidence: A Taxonomy and Proof of Concept of Anti-Forensic Attacks on LLM-Assisted Digital Investigations
title_zh: LLM辅助数字取证中的反取证提示注入攻击分类与概念验证
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are entering digital forensics as examination assistants and autonomous agents. Digital forensics inverts the usual setting for indirect prompt injection: the evidence under analysis is attacker-controlled by definition, and the examiner is obliged to read it closely. This makes the reasoning layer a new anti-forensic target, next to the classical ones of data and tools. Classical anti-forensic taxonomies do not cover it, and prompt injection defences do not anticipate it. We extend the anti-forensic model to reflect the manipulation of reasoning, and present a taxonomy of attacks carried through adversarial evidence: an attacker selects an objective, a technique, a payload location, and a concealment method. We observe a perception gap, i.e., the fact that deterministic tools, the human examiner, and the model perceive the same evidence differently, which is what lets an injection reach the model unseen by the examiner. We demonstrate three attacks against an LLM-assisted analysis pipeline, changing a reported conclusion, writing attacker-chosen content to the analyst's workstation, and causing outbound network traffic, each driven only by text planted on the seized device. Mitigations to these attacks are also proposed.
summary_zh: LLM用于数字取证时，攻击者控制证据可实施间接提示注入，使推理层成为新型反取证目标。
扩展反取证模型并提出攻击分类法，揭示确定性工具、人类与LLM对证据感知差异导致的注入盲区。
演示三种通过篡改设备文本发起的攻击，可改变结论或越权写入与外联，并提出缓解措施。

title: Engineering Requirements for Generative AI Agents: The BARD Process Theory
title_zh: 生成式AI智能体的需求工程：BARD过程理论
abstract: How teams engineer requirements for systems built around Generative AI (GenAI) Agents remains empirically uncharted. Existing Requirements Engineering (RE) research mainly addresses AI and ML-based systems broadly but provides no process account for agentic systems, whose non-deterministic behavior cannot be anticipated at design time. To understand how teams actually proceed, we applied Socio-Technical Grounded Theory across 36 semi-structured interviews with practitioners, interleaving data collection and analysis so that emerging findings drove our theoretical sampling and shaped successive rounds of coding. The result is Behavioral Agent Requirement Discovery (BARD), the process theory of RE for GenAI Agents. BARD holds that requirements are not fixed up front but discovered through a recurring cycle of four activities: teams scope the need, build the agent, observe its behavior, and revise what they ask for. Through this four-phase loop, the requirement evolves from a fixed specification towards behavioral and evaluation criteria. Four tensions drive transitions between phases, and two conditions frame the loop. BARD provides researchers with a framework for iteratively refining RE workflows, while giving practitioners a structured basis to embed into their development processes.
summary_zh: 现有需求工程研究缺乏针对GenAI智能体非确定性行为的过程描述，需探索其实际需求工程流程。
基于社会技术扎根理论，对36位从业者进行半结构化访谈，交替进行数据收集与分析。
提出BARD过程理论，认为需求通过范围界定、构建、观察和修订四阶段循环发现，为研究与开发提供结构化基础。
comment: Accepted at the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027)

title: Monitorability Is Trainable: Post-Training for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
title_zh: 可监控性是可训练的：提升思维链可监控性的后训练方法
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the few practical tools available for overseeing capable AI systems, but it is fragile: a model's reasoning is only useful to a monitor if it remains coupled to what the model actually does. This coupling can be degraded during training through, for example, CoT compression, optimization against a monitor, and out-of-context generalization from synthetic documents. In this work, we propose an unsupervised post-training objective based on maximizing mutual information between CoT and the output for improving CoT monitorability. Across three model organisms with degraded CoT, it recovers most or all of the lost monitorability. Applied to undegraded policies, it further improves judged monitorability, improves prediction of unsafe behavior by CoT monitors and activation probes, and increases the prevalence of consequential reasoning. These results suggest that monitorability should be treated as a trainable attribute of the policy. A dedicated monitorability post-training stage can extend current practices that protect CoT from direct optimization pressure.
summary_zh: CoT监控依赖推理与模型行为的耦合，但训练中的压缩或优化等操作会破坏该耦合，导致可监控性下降。
提出一种无监督后训练目标，通过最大化CoT与输出的互信息来恢复和提升CoT的可监控性。
实验表明该方法能恢复受损的可监控性，增强对不安全行为的预测，表明可监控性应作为可训练属性。
comment: The first two authors contributed equally

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
title_zh: 检索增强生成组合性研究
abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.
summary_zh: 现有RAG技术多孤立评估，其组合后增益是否存留、检索与忠实度是否一致、小规模结论能否泛化均未知。
提出LASAGNA框架，在8个基准和5K至200K文档规模上，对450种RAG配置进行受控组合评估。
发现孤立强技术组合增益大幅衰减，优化检索与忠实度存在冲突，且最优组合随语料库规模变化。
comment: 103 pages (9 main), 15 figures, 68 tables. Project page: https://dolev31.github.io/lasagna/ Code: https://github.com/dolev31/lasagna

title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
title_zh: CausGround：面向自适应具身规划的因果交互接地框架
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.
summary_zh: MLLM缺乏环境相关的动作前提与效应知识，现有适应方法成本高或经验难复用。
提出非参数框架CausGround，将交互经验提炼为可复用的动作中心因果知识，并分解表示世界状态。
规划时将因果依赖接地于当前观测，支持前提后向推理与效应前向推理，显著提升规划与推理成功率。

title: Benchmarking Coding Agents for System-Level Performance Optimization
title_zh: 面向系统级性能优化的编程智能体基准测试
abstract: Coding agents are becoming an increasingly important paradigm for automating software engineering tasks. However, existing coding benchmarks primarily evaluate agents at the function or repository level, leaving their capabilities in more complex distributed software systems largely unexplored. In practice, many modern applications adopt microservice architectures, where end-to-end performance emerges from interactions among multiple independently running services, requiring agents to reason beyond local code changes. To study this capability, we introduce MicroPerf-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on end-to-end performance optimization in microservice systems. Constructing such a benchmark is challenging because reproducible system-level performance fixes are sparse and difficult to attribute. We address this challenge by injecting empirically grounded performance anti-patterns into real-world open-source systems while preserving functionality and ensuring measurable performance degradation. The resulting benchmark contains 65 optimization instances across seven systems and nine anti-patterns, each with an executable environment, functional tests, and mixed-workload evaluation. Across 1,755 runs covering nine agent-model configurations, the best configuration recovers only 42.0% of the injected performance degradation. The dominant failure is not invalid code, but functionally correct and constraint-compliant changes that fail to improve end-to-end performance, highlighting system-level bottleneck localization as a key challenge for current coding agents. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/zyzcjnb/microperf.
summary_zh: 现有编程智能体基准多关注函数或仓库级，缺乏对微服务系统端到端性能优化能力的评估。
提出MicroPerf-Bench基准，通过向开源系统注入性能反模式构建可复现的优化实例，共含65个实例。
实验表明最佳配置仅恢复42%的性能退化，主要失败原因为未能定位系统级瓶颈而非代码错误。

title: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
title_zh: TraceForge：基于自身思维风格的推理轨迹蒸馏
abstract: Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term. We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates. We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.
summary_zh: 前沿模型仅返回答案而隐藏推理轨迹，现有恢复方法违反服务条款，需合规替代方案。
提出TraceForge，以上下文和教师答案为输入，生成符合学生模型家族风格的推理轨迹，采用监督与对抗两阶段训练。
在编程基准测试中，生成轨迹击败模型原生思维内容，HumanEval+提升3.7分，MBPP+提升7.1分。

title: Uni-Mem: Learning a Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Manager with Unified Online Policy Optimization
title_zh: Uni-Mem：基于统一在线策略优化的长周期智能体记忆管理器
abstract: Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. To this end, we propose Stage-Decoupled GRPO, which alternates construction and retrieval optimization while controlling variation from the other stage within each rollout group, yielding stage-specific learning signals. We further introduce Event-Wise Credit Assignment (ECA), which localizes feedback to responsible events and propagates event-level advantages to their constituent operations. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Uni-Mem outperforms the strongest RL-based memory, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning memory construction and retrieval via Stage-Decoupled GRPO and ECA.
summary_zh: 现有智能体记忆学习方法难以实现记忆构建与检索的协同优化，本文提出端到端统一记忆管理器Uni-Mem。
针对联合优化中GRPO存在的组比较混淆与长轨迹稀疏反馈问题，提出Stage-Decoupled GRPO解耦两阶段优化。
引入Event-Wise Credit Assignment将反馈定位至关键事件并传播优势，实验证明Uni-Mem联合学习构建与检索的有效性。

title: Learning to Reason Like a Cytopathologist:Clinically Grounded Multiscale Evidential Learning for Cervical Cytology
title_zh: 细胞病理学家式推理：宫颈细胞学的临床多尺度证据学习
abstract: Cervical cytology presents a fundamentally ambiguous diagnostic landscape, where equivocal categories such as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) occupy a morphological grey zone that is definitional. For clinical decision support, the goal extends beyond assigning a definitive label to every sample: cases must also be distinguished by whether the available evidence supports a confident decision or warrants further consideration, a distinction conventional classification models are not designed to explicitly represent. We propose a multiscale evidential framework that models cervical cytology along an ordinal disease continuum using clinically grounded soft anchors, representing progression from benign reactive changes to precancerous lesions and malignancy. Three biologically motivated spatial contexts--nuclear morphology, cytoplasmic characteristics, and neighbourhood cellular architecture--are independently encoded using a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, preserving inter-scale disagreement that early fusion may obscure. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster--Shafer belief masses and fused with reliability discounting, allowing conflicting evidence and insufficient support to remain explicitly uncommitted rather than forcing a decision. The fused belief state drives interpretable routing that separates confidently classified cases from those with irreducible evidential insufficiency, enabling clinically meaningful triage. Across two independent publicly available conventional cytology datasets, RIVA and CRIC Cervix, the framework generalises consistently, with uncertainty strongly associated with diagnostic difficulty: incorrect predictions carry 1.94x-4.13x higher uncertainty than correct ones.
summary_zh: 宫颈细胞学存在形态学灰区，传统分类模型无法区分高置信决策与需进一步考量的证据不足情况。
提出多尺度证据框架，用DINOv2独立编码核、浆及邻域特征，通过Dempster-Shafer融合保留证据冲突与不足。
框架实现可解释分流，在两数据集上泛化稳定，且错误预测的不确定性显著高于正确预测。

title: Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?
title_zh: 游戏中适得其反的反馈：LLM会重复刚失败的走法吗？
abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.
summary_zh: LLM在游戏中走法失败后，记录失败信息会使其更倾向重复该非法走法，导致反馈适得其反。
记录失败后，模型对失败走法的对数概率几乎不依赖其先验概率，原本不倾向的走法变可能，倾向的走法变不确定。
省略走法字符串的失败描述可保留模型偏好，DPO阶段能消除此反转，而禁止重复指令或干净重试均无效。
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Code, probe items and raw records: https://github.com/Esmail-ibraheem/feedback-that-backfires/tree/games

title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
title_zh: CineEvolve：面向电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体自进化框架
abstract: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.
summary_zh: 现有电影级多镜头视频生成缺乏叙事推理或依赖无策略更新的前馈流程，难以实现迭代优化。
提出CineEvolve框架，统一Director与Critic，通过交替强化学习使两者协同进化以修正视频缺陷。
引入E-GRPO稳定训练，并构建CineTraj数据集，实验表明该方法显著优于现有方案。

title: SatCraft: Agentic Optimization of Scheduling Policies for Satellite-Cellular Edge Services
title_zh: SatCraft：卫星蜂窝边缘服务调度策略的智能体优化
